$comment: DENMARK LEGISLATION EXTRACTION — the SIGNED L-449 Plandata FIELD→C63 mapping, applied PER-PLAN.
Denmark's legislation is per-PLAN (lokalplan / lokalplandelomraade / kommuneplanramme), NOT a static
per-zone dictionary like Zurich's BZO. So this file is NOT a zone table with one row per zone — it is
the extraction RULE: the mapping from each machine-readable Plandata WFS attribute to a C63 envelope
output, with its BR18 citation, densityScope treatment, and confidence. The 'values' are resolved
per-parcel at query time from whatever governing plan Plandata returns; what is fixed (and signed) is
the MAPPING below. This mirrors the Sweden 'offline-legislation + deferred-live-data' shape.
HONESTY: no per-city composite % is hand-typed here. 'structured' = Plandata delivers the field
machine-readably; 'unknown' = the field is legitimately empty/unencoded per-plan (a data-quality or
scope-encoding residual), NOT a code gap. Every mapped output cites a BR18 section or a WFS field.
structureNote: A parcel resolves to its governing instrument via the chain point → byggefelt → lokalplandelomraade → lokalplan → kommuneplanramme (tightest that publishes a number; §USABLE-FALLBACK, L-608). The mapping below applies to whichever instrument governs; it is NOT keyed to a fixed zone list.

partA_legislation.description: The reachable win — Plandata WFS attributes mapped to C63 envelope outputs. These are the ~96% that IS reachable because Plandata delivers them machine-readably (no PDF read).

fields.legalBasis: BR18 §168–186: bebyggelsesprocent = 'etagearealets procentvise andel af grundens areal' (gross floor area / site area × 100) — a floor-area ratio, NOT ground coverage.

densityScope.attribute: beregningsgrundlag (denominator scope) — NOT yet ingested by the current mapper

values.parcel: det enkelte matrikelnummer / grundens areal → FAR = pct/100 is a usable envelope number
values.property: den enkelte ejendom (may span several matrikler) → FAR WITHHELD (null + cited reason)
values.planningArea: området som helhed / under ét (shared budget) → FAR WITHHELD (null + cited reason)

densityScope.default: unknown → FAR withheld (unknown != parcel; assuming per-parcel would mis-scale a whole-area value — §CONTEXT-DATA-HONESTY / envelope-solid-overstates-partial-data)
densityScope.note: Height and storeys are absolute caps → scope-independent → always pass through. Only the FAR ratio is scope-gated. The engine's FAR denominator (farLimitedHeight.ts) is hardwired to parcel area, so only a parcel-scoped FAR is correct to feed it.

fields.unknownWhen: Plandata leaves bebygpct empty for the governing plan → honest 'unknown' (per-plan data-quality, not a code gap). Also 'unknown' whenever densityScope is not parcel or not encoded → FAR withheld.
Plandata leaves maxbygnhjd empty for the governing plan → honest 'unknown'.

fields.rule: floor to an int (decimal in source e.g. 3.5 incl. attic → floored; never over-stated)
fields.unknownWhen: Plandata leaves maxetager empty for the governing plan → honest 'unknown'.

fields.rule: classified onto the C58 closed vocabulary (mapPlandataToZoningRecord)
fields.legalBasis: Planloven anvendelseskategori (use category on the adopted plan feature)

fields.rule: null — NO plan-field source. Plandata's standard plan fields publish no ground-coverage %. bebygpct is FAR not coverage; reusing it would be a fabrication. byggefelt gives a footprint polygon (not a %); coverage would need parcel geometry (absent in the pure mapper). See L-609/L-611.
fields.unknownReason: no-source (Denmark is coverage-and-FAR / height-and-storeys governed, not coverage-published). ~1.4% of byzone clicks could derive a byggefelt-footprint coverage via an ADR-gated cross-layer path — kept DISTINCT from the dimensional fill; see roadmap G3/G7.

fields.rule: null — SEPARATE Plandata dataset, not carried on the plan feature. null != 0 (an absent setback is unknown, not a required-zero). NEVER map any line to front/rear/side = 5. See roadmap G2.

partB_parcel.description: PARCEL geometry provider — national survey-grade, but credential/access-DEFERRED. This is an access gap (MitID identity gate), NOT a code gap and NOT fabricatable (C58 §1.4).

primary.access: Datafordeler — administrator/service-user bootstrap requires a Danish MitID identity PRYZM cannot obtain (same access class as Swedish BankID)
primary.liveClaim: NONE — do not claim live parcel access
primary.code: packages/site-parcel-data/src/parcelProviders/dkMatrikelParcelProvider.ts — a DEFERRED STUB on the canonical interface: fetchParcelAtPoint returns null (no live access attempted), never-throws, typed OTel span. The Datafordeler adapter is a single method-body swap behind the '// DEFERRED:' seam.

fallback.behaviour: when the stub returns null the registry falls back to the OSM footprint — graceful, honestly labelled, never a fabricated parcel

partC_meta.description: META — the register the PART A mapping reads from.
partC_meta.register: Plandata.dk — the Danish national plan register (Erhvervsstyrelsen / Danish Business Authority)
partC_meta.coverage: national (all of Denmark; one register, no per-municipality variation of the schema)
partC_meta.crs: EPSG:25832 (ETRS89 / UTM 32N) — metric; shoelace yields m² directly
partC_meta.proxy: server/plandataZoningProxy.js (keyless same-origin WFS proxy + coordinate cache)

honestResidual.statement: Denmark's legislation is structured + signed → the C63 LEGISLATION axis is DERIVED-READY as a structured-national-prior (~96% national ceiling). The remaining measurement, still to run, is the PER-CITY Plandata-population fraction: the fraction of a city's lokalplaner/rammer with populated Plandata fields. That is a MEASUREMENT, not a hand-typed number. Until it is run per city, the per-city LEGISLATION cell stays not-assessed (no country-prior borrow — §CONTEXT-DATA-HONESTY).
openItems: densityScope (beregningsgrundlag) WFS attribute not yet ingested — scope treated as unknown → FAR withheld until wired (probe-don't-assume the exact field name; parseDkDensityScope ready). See roadmap G1.
§USABLE-FALLBACK instrument precedence — Danish-planner legal sign-off PENDING (VERIFICATION.md).
byggefelt bindingness semantics (bygvejledende / bygkunifelt / iomfangreg) — Danish-planner sign-off PENDING; gates any byggefelt→maxCoverage treatment. See roadmap G3/G7.
honestResidual.l449Gate: No field serves at confidence 'human-reviewed' until sources/VERIFICATION.md carries the Danish-planner sign-off. The published numbers are already cited to doklink at confidence 'structured'.

gapRoadmap.description: The envelope-REALISM roadmap (see DENMARK-GAP-ROADMAP.md for full prose + implementation detail). These gaps affect ENVELOPE / HEIGHTS-LOD / CONTEXT / PARCEL / TERRAIN realism, NOT the ~96% legislation rate — the rate stays. Every gap keeps an honest unknown/withhold; no fabricated coverage/setback/courtyard/height.
gapRoadmap.canonical: G1..G9 + tail queue; founder topic-labels reconciled in the roadmap doc

gaps.name: density denominator scope (beregningsgrundlag)
gaps.status: current rule 'unknown scope → withhold FAR' is CORRECT — keep it; probe DescribeFeatureType for the scope attribute

gaps.name: setbacks (byggelinjer)
gaps.status: model as BuildingLineConstraint{binding:'unknown', distanceM:null}; never front/rear/side numbers; distinguish byggelinje vs vejbyggelinje vs byggefelt; edge-match by geometry not orientation; 3-phase P1 byggelinjer/P2 Barcelona-alignment/P3 lokalplan-text

gaps.name: byggefelt semantics / binding flag
gaps.status: binding:'unknown' until DescribeFeatureType-probe of bygvejledende/iomfangreg/bygkunifelt + model-doc + Danish-planner sign-off; gates G6 placement and G7 coverage; never coverage=byggefelt.area/parcel.area

gaps.name: LoD2 building context adapter (GeoDanmark + Danmark i 3D + DHM + BBR)
gaps.status: ESTIMATED (~93-95%) → VERIFIED only after the N=500 measurement runs; LoD2 roof surfaces not LOD1 extrusion; physical height = DSM-DTM, not planning maxbygnhjd

gaps.name: buildable-depth from lokalplan TEXT
gaps.status: ordinance-pipeline text extraction (byggedybde/bygningens dybde/maksimal dybde) → buildableDepthM{source:'lokalplan §X.X', confidence:'official-text'}; study-mode fallback only, NEVER legalDepth

gaps.name: courtyard / friareal / perimeter-block (karré)
gaps.affects: ENVELOPE — biggest realism failure (courtyards vanish → density overstated)
gaps.status: dkEnvelopeGeometryProvider hierarchy binding-byggefelt→byggelinjer→lokalplan-depth-text→study-mode; REUSE the Barcelona profunditat-edificable engine; never FAR→footprint; never fabricate courtyard dims

gaps.name: maxCoverage (ground-coverage %)
gaps.status: null today (CORRECT); 4-tier resolver binding-byggefelt(official)/lokalplan-clause(text-derived)/kommuneplan/null; classifier rejects bebyggelsesprocent+etageareal (those are FAR); expected usable ~10-30% nationally; NEVER maxCoverage=farRatio

gaps.name: parcel provider (Matriklen)
gaps.status: access-deferred (MitID gate); 3 solution paths (A official Datafordeler via MitID Erhverv / B municipal-open mirrors confidence:'regional' / C partner ingestion — most practical); env DK_DATAFORDELER_CLIENT_ID/_SECRET; area via shoelace on EPSG:25832 never WGS84; OSM fallback labeled source:'OSM' confidence:'approximate' never cadastre

gaps.name: the honest ceiling (last ~4%)
gaps.status: ~96% digital / ~87% pure-structured; NOT 100% (structural + measurement, not fabricatable); residual = born-digital-text + scan-OCR minority + plan-omitted; mirrors Germany §34-floor honesty
